page.content:
Bandai Namco's Mishima saga — Zaibatsu, Devil Gene, and the Iron Fist tournament.

How Tekken connects

  • Event: King of Iron Fist Tournament — The King of Iron Fist Tournament is the contest every numbered Tekken opens.
  • Faction: Mishima Zaibatsu — The Mishima Zaibatsu is the company the Tekken saga wars over.
  • Concept: Devil Gene — The Devil Gene is the curse that drives the Mishima saga.
  • Work: Tekken 3 — Tekken 3 is the game that passed the lead to Jin.
  • Work: Tekken 8 — Tekken 8 is the modern climax of the Mishima blood war.
  • Work: Tekken 2 — Tekken 2 is the sequel that seated Kazuya on the Zaibatsu throne.
  • Work: Tekken 7 — Tekken 7 closed Heihachi's war with Kazuya.

What is Tekken?

Tekken is the fighting saga of the Mishima bloodline: Heihachi, Kazuya, and Jin warring over the Mishima Zaibatsu, the Devil Gene, and the King of Iron Fist Tournament from the first arcade game through Tekken 8.

Key threads lead to King of Iron Fist Tournament, Mishima Zaibatsu, Devil Gene, Tekken 3, Tekken 8 and Tekken 2.
